name: Poulan Pro PP4818AVX
blurb: Oregon's fit guide, one row under PP4818AVX: 18″ bar, standard 3/8″ pitch, .050″ gauge, 66 drive links (Oregon D66). Not the low-profile 18″ loop.
intro: Oregon's saw-chain selection guide prints PP4818AVX on its own line with one chain under it: D66, 18″, 66 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ pitch. In this guide the low-profile chains are marked “Low Profile”; this row is not. It is standard 3/8″, the same pitch family as Oregon's D-series, not the 3/8″ low-profile S62 loop used on many 18″ Poulan saws. The guide does not print a file size.

bars.note: Oregon's saw-chain selection guide prints D66 directly under PP4818AVX: 18″ bar, 66 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″. The guide does not print a file size or a Poulan part number for this row.

sources.title: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide, Poulan / Poulan Pro section: one chain row printed directly under the model

sources_note: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide (apps.oregonproducts.com/pdfs/TSC-Chain-Fit-Guide.pdf), Poulan / Poulan Pro section, read 5 Nov 2026. Only models with a single chain row printed directly under the model name are listed. Models that share a block of several chain lengths are not given a page here.
